workspaces.purpose: Isolated Eventstream publisher blast radius, Eventhouse/KQL, landing Lakehouse, and RTI assets.
Curated core Lakehouse, notebooks, and Data Pipelines; no ingress publisher access.
Fabric Data Science, experiments, evaluations, and approved model artifacts.
Direct Lake semantic model and Power BI/board reporting.

manualGates: Confirm the workspace is assigned to a running supported Fabric capacity.
Validate retention/cache cost and cold-start behavior in the target tenant.

items.description: Immutable bronze envelopes and quarantine landing.
manualGates: Apply and verify current OneLake security roles and sensitivity label.
Verify that no shortcut crosses the demo/non-demo boundary.

items.description: Typed silver facts, SCD dimensions, and gold KPI tables.
manualGates: Apply and verify current OneLake security roles and sensitivity label.
Confirm the workspace identity/notebook identity can read landing and write core only.

items.description: Hot telemetry, alarms, gateway health, inference, and quarantine.
manualGates: Measure retention/cache cost and adjust environment retention values.
Confirm KQL query/ingestion endpoints and item identity support before production.

items.description: Create Delta medallion tables and reference targets idempotently.
manualGates: Attach or authorize the landing/core Lakehouses for the notebook execution identity.

items.description: Validate, deduplicate, normalize, SCD-resolve, and quarantine bronze events.
manualGates: Validate event-time SCD joins, unit registry, watermark, and replay behavior with a fixed batch.

items.description: Build governed daily/shift KPI facts and decision/audit projections.
manualGates: Business owners must sign off KPI definitions before production reporting.

items.description: Synthetic-only deterministic RUL and quality demo scoring.
manualGates: Run only against SYNTHETIC data; this rule-based scorer is not a promoted production model.
A production model requires MLflow evaluation, model card, drift gates, and RAI approval.

items.description: Reconciliation, contract, physical, and scenario quality gate.
manualGates: A run is demo-ready only when contract, physics, and scenario assertions pass.

items.description: Initialize and run bronze-to-silver-to-gold with a quality gate.
manualGates: Bind the current notebook job identity and test a fixed-batch row reconciliation.
Configure schedules only after capacity pause windows are excluded.

items.description: Run deterministic synthetic scoring then refresh gold quality checks.
manualGates: Keep this pipeline disabled outside synthetic dev/test/demo workspaces.

items.description: Managed-identity Custom Endpoint with hot KQL and immutable bronze routes.
manualGates: Retrieve the generated Custom Endpoint details and prove Entra managed-identity publishing.
Use Fabric CLI/portal to grant the publisher identity Contributor only on RTI-Ingress.
Test duplicate, late, invalid-unit, unknown-asset, and malformed-message behavior.
Do not enable ingestion while the capacity is paused.

items.description: Direct Lake NovaSteel KPI model over governed gold Delta tables.
manualGates: Validate the Direct Lake source binding against the core Lakehouse SQL endpoint.
Validate RLS/persona plant scope using test identities; UI hiding is not authorization.
Confirm every report consumer has Pro/PPU/trial below F64.
Apply sensitivity label and test refresh/query before setting semanticModelBindingValidated=true.

manualAssets.reason: Queries and visual metadata are portable, but datasource IDs, dashboard layout/export format, and permissions must be validated from a tenant-exported KQL dashboard definition before API deployment.
completionEvidence: All queries in rti/dashboard-queries.kql run against kql-ns-operations.
Freshness, gateway state, active alarms, model score, and quarantine visuals render.
A tenant-exported definition is checked in before enabling automated import.

manualAssets.reason: Rule actions require tenant-bound Teams/email/Power Automate connections, DLP/licensing review, and owner routing.
completionEvidence: Rules notify or enrich only; no safety, OT, schedule commit, or capacity action exists.
State transition, deduplication, recovery, and alert-storm suppression are tested.
A human owner confirms notification targets and escalation policy.

manualAssets.reason: PBIR/report layouts depend on the tenant-bound semantic model, RLS, labels, and internal user-owned-data embedding configuration.
completionEvidence: Executive, sustainability, and persona report pages bind only to sm-ns-operations.
RLS and export permissions pass persona tests.
A tenant-exported PBIR definition is checked in before REST/CLI import.

manualAssets.reason: Role APIs and item/security capabilities must be verified in the target tenant; broad workspace roles are not a substitute for OneLake data security.
completionEvidence: Publisher identity has no DataCore, ML, Analytics, or production access.
Persona and service identities pass least-privilege read/write tests.
Monthly role export is retained as release evidence.
